title: DeploymentManifest
description: Contract addresses for one chain. Path: packages/contracts/deployments/<chainId>.json. Addresses and a timestamp only; no keys or RPC URLs.

chainId.description: EVM chain id. Local Hardhat is 31337.

feeRecipient.description: Platform fee recipient configured on the factory.

deployedAt.description: UTC time this manifest was written, from Date.toISOString().
